sequentialTasks.task: PROMISE-CONSISTENCY A1: canonical promise-settlement rule from deep analysis fanout
sequentialTasks.description: Hana directive: tokenizer.go uses Adapter.NewPromise+bare-goroutine while fetch/readable_stream.go wrapReaderJS uses Loop.Promisify (shutdown tracking) — inconsistent. Ground truth already established first-hand (goalLog 9). Integrate findings from background agents bg_6d234820 (settlement-site inventory: file:line, pattern, loop-held vs adapter-only, I/O class, shutdown gap) and bg_fd728d66 (Promisify vs NewPromise decision matrix from fork source). Produce and record ONE canonical rule: which sites must migrate to loop.Promisify (work that must survive/complete across loop lifecycle: disk writes, spawns, network, listener teardown), which may stay NewPromise+goroutine (short-lived, process-scoped, justified), and how *Loop is threaded to bindings that need it (fetch eventLoopProvider.Loop() pattern is precedent; check 'no loop fields on structs' constraint vs Require-time threading). Classify every inventoried site against the rule. OUTCOME (agent-integrated, both bg tasks complete): CANONICAL RULE — every goroutine-backed binding settlement must be shutdown-tracked via loop.Promisify; where the result must be JS-visible, bridge via adapter.NewPromise settler on the owner (Promisify->settler bridge). Rationale from fork source: Promisify provides promisifyCount liveness (auto-exit cannot fire mid-I/O), promisifyWg graceful-Shutdown drain, ErrGoexit/PanicError guards, guaranteed settlement fallback, ErrLoopTerminated admission rejection; NewPromise+settler alone has ZERO lifecycle coupling and silently consumes its one settlement attempt if Submit fails (promise pending forever); Adapter-only CANNOT reproduce tracking (Done()=release gate, TrackAbortSignal=cancellation). Inventory (bg_6d234820): 42 goroutine-backed sites — 31 via async.Promise helper (NewPromise+bare-goroutine root), 11 direct bare-goroutine (fetch/fetch.go:70, mcpcallback 297/746, tokenizer 96, termmux 616/678/1950/2066/2294, mcpmod 342, js_output_api 62), only 4 tracked Promisify (bt require.go:327, readable_stream:167, runtime.go:115, tui_manager:779). Clearest inconsistency: bt/require.go does the SAME ticker-wait via Promisify(327) AND async.Promise(353). Loop-holders today: fetch, bt, grpc(inprocgrpc), scripting, bubbletea(indirect); adapter-only: tokenizer, exec, mcp, mcpcallback, aimux, os, path, ctxutil, gitops, astpack, difftriage, termmux. JUSTIFIED EXCEPTIONS (stay as-is): sync NewPromise settles (exec 31/40, mcpcb 554/700/736, tokenizer 92, fetch 58 — validation, no goroutine); runtime.NewPromise sync resolves (fetch 192-203); adapter.Submit fire-and-forget trampolines (11 sites, not work settlements). IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE for A2: upgrade internal/builtin/async/promise.go with a loop-aware tracked helper (bridge pattern), thread *Loop into adapter-only module Requires following fetch precedent Require(ctx, adapter, loop), migrate Tier-1 (loop-in-scope: fetch 70/sse 219/readable_stream 180 fallback, js_output_api 62, bt 353/415) then Tier-2 (threaded modules).
